description.value:
Your pure heart and worthy deeds have drawn the friendship of a unicorn with a spirit as noble as your own. You gain the service of a young unicorn companion even if you would otherwise be unable to choose it. If you already have an animal companion, you can immediately retrain the feat that granted you that animal companion.

You also become attuned to nature's graceful mysteries. You become an expert in Diplomacy and gain the following edict and anathema.

Edict cherish and protect the beauty and dignity of nature and its creatures

Anathema tolerate the abuse of nature and its creatures If you perform enough acts described by this anathema, your unicorn abandons you until you repent by conducting an atone ritual; this ritual's primary and secondary checks can use either Nature or Religion.

value.value: can't be an aberration, undead, or unholy
